subject: MedStripe kickoff — final calendar, attendees, and runbook
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena@medstripe.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff — availability and attendees

Hi Sean,

Thanks for partnering with us — excited to get started. We'd like to schedule the customer kickoff next week to align on timelines, technical pre-reqs, and success criteria. Our core attendees will be: me (product), Samir Patel (platform lead), and one of our SREs from ops (ops@medstripe.com).

Availability windows (PDT):
- Tue 10/13 between 9–11am
- Wed 10/14 between 1–4pm
- Fri 10/16 afternoon after 2pm

Can you share a proposed agenda and any pre-reads? Also let us know if we need to loop in any additional Redwood folks.

Best,
Elena Cruz
Head of Product, MedStripe
elena@medstripe.com

---

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Cruz <elena@medstripe.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — availability and attendees

Team — forwarding MedStripe's availability. Quick proposed plan:
- Owners: Monica (CS lead / kickoff), Laura (implementation owner / tech walkthrough), Rishi (runtime/perf + SLA overview), me (AM / agenda and next steps)
- Draft agenda (high level): 1) Introductions & goals (10m), 2) Implementation crosswalk + infra checklist (25m), 3) Data/keys and security + KMS questions (15m), 4) Timeline & milestones + mutual action plan (15m), 5) Next steps & action owners (5m)

Monica — can you take kickoff facilitation? Laura — please prepare short slides for infra checklist and share the drive link. Rishi — flag any known pre-reqs we should confirm before the call.

I'll propose two times back to Elena based on their windows: Wed 10/14 1:30pm PDT or Fri 10/16 2:30pm PDT. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
(415) 555-0217

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: Elena Cruz <elena@medstripe.com>, Samir Patel <samir@medstripe.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: MedStripe kickoff — calendar invite + agenda + runbook link

Hi Elena and Samir — confirmed times below and agenda attached. Let us know which option works and we'll send a calendar invite.

Proposed options (PDT):
- Option A (preferred): Wed 14 Oct, 1:30–2:30pm PDT
- Option B: Fri 16 Oct, 2:30–3:30pm PDT

Draft agenda (attached: redwood_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) Implementation crosswalk — roles, network & infra checklist (20m)
3) Security & data flow (KMS, logs, retention) (15m)
4) Timeline & mutual action plan (10m)
5) Q&A, blockers and immediate next steps (5m)

Pre-reads: implementation_crosswalk.xlsx in the shared runbook folder — high level mvp scope + optional integrations.
Call links (Zoom + calendar stub):
- Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=medstripe_kickoff
- Calendar (ICS/Google): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=medstripe-kickoff-icid

Attachments: redwood_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf (attached)
Runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/medstripe-onboarding-runbook

If you confirm Option A I'll send the invite for the Wed slot.

Best,
Sean

Team — MedStripe confirmed Option A. I created the calendar invite for Wed 14 Oct 1:30pm–2:30pm PDT (Zoom link above). Action items before the call:
- Laura: share infra checklist slides in the runbook (deadline Mon 10/19 EOD) and attach implementation_crosswalk.xlsx to the invite.
- Monica: lead intros & capture success criteria; prepare the 3 success metrics we want to align on.
- Rishi: prepare an SLA slide (latency/availability targets) and a short note on fallback model variants.
- Ops: MedStripe will add their SRE to the invite (Samir cc'd).

Attachments included in this thread: redwood_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf, implementation_crosswalk.xlsx
